sanitization: Absolute home-directory paths replaced with $HOME and the scratch workspace path with $SCRATCH. No secret values, tokens or account identifiers are present.

contents.help/: Exact `sbx <cmd> [<sub>] --help` output for every documented command and subcommand (invalid nested names were discarded, not invented).
contents.state/: Real outputs: `sbx version`; `sbx daemon status` (stopped, running, and --json running); `sbx ls` / `sbx ls --json` with zero sandboxes; `sbx ls --json` run while the daemon was stopped, which auto-started it (side effect: 'Starting sandboxd daemon...').
contents.errors/: Real error outputs (format `error: <msg>` + `  try: <hint>`, exit 1): create before `sbx policy init`, stop/rm of a missing sandbox, and `sbx ls` while the daemon was stopped (transcribed from session output; exit code not recorded).
contents.crud/: Real lifecycle round trip on a disposable `shell` sandbox over an empty scratch workspace, after the user ran `sbx policy init balanced`: create (exit 0) → ls --json (one row: name, id, agent, status, last_used_at, workspaces[], created_at) → ls text table → exec echo → daemon status --json → stop ('state preserved; restart with sbx run --name') → ls --json (status stopped) → rm --force → ls --json (empty) → rm --force of the missing sandbox (error, exit 1). Note: rows use `status`, not the `state` field assumed by the illustrative ../../list.json.

not_captured: Interactive `sbx run` (agent attach/restart), ports/policy/secrets/MCP state, and any agent other than `shell`. Agents needing provider sign-in (codex, claude, …) were not created.
policy_note: Global network policy was initialized by the user (`sbx policy init balanced`, 2026-10-09) before the crud/ capture; the earlier errors/create_policy_not_initialized.txt shows the pre-init refusal.
